## About
Rehab Tavern is an old-style bar and grill in Columbus. We call it a clean dive: a short drive, a relaxed room and a good place to meet up with friends.
There's panini and artisanal beers, trivia games, a jukebox, a patio and sports on. One reviewer mentioned live music on the weekends, local art on the walls, darts and a pool table.
Neighbors have given us a 4.4 rating across 631 Google reviews. If you're planning a get-together, you can book an event with us too.

## Services
- Panini and artisanal beers: Panini and a selection of artisanal beers in an old-style bar.
- Trivia, jukebox and sports: Trivia games, a jukebox to pick the music and sports to watch, with a patio when you want some air.
- Event booking: Planning a party or get-together? Reach out to book an event at Rehab.

## FAQ
Q: Can I book an event at Rehab Tavern?
A: Yes. You can book an event with us through our website or give us a call.

Q: Is there live music?
A: One reviewer mentioned live music on the weekends. Check our Facebook page for what's coming up.

Q: Do you have a patio?
A: Yes, there's a patio along with the jukebox and sports inside.
